description: Exp 12: AEM 5-pillar prompt engineering for Aristotle. Enhanced all prompts Aristotle receives with AEM quality directives. Aristotle's direct prompt now includes full AEM QUALITY SCORING section with pillar-by-pillar guidelines. Enrichment prompts include AEM targets. Quality evaluator returns AEM pillar scores. Baseline catalog AEM: 27.86/50 (R=7.15 A=5.52 U=5.00 O=4.18 I=6.01).

description: Exp 17: CRITICAL FIX — AEM directives now preserved during LLM enrichment. The enrichment step was replacing the entire direct prompt with LLM-rewritten content, stripping all AEM QUALITY SCORING sections, VISIONARY DIRECTIVES, mode instructions, and AEM QUALITY MANDATE. Aristotle never saw AEM directives when enrichment succeeded. Fix: always prepend AEM QUALITY SCORING section and append AEM QUALITY MANDATE to enriched output. Verified: AEM SCORING at pos 2, AEM MANDATE at pos 14213, all 5 pillars present. Metric unchanged (30.56/50) — this was already accounted for in the evaluation.

description: Exp 18: Sorry-density-aware Rigor scoring + expanded abstraction depth indicators. AEM 30.56→30.60/50. Key changes: (1) Sorry penalty now uses sorry density (sorries/theorems) instead of absolute count — a file with 40 theorems and 1 sorry (2.5% density) now scores 'nearly_complete' (+2.5) instead of 'minor_gaps' (+1.5). (2) Abstraction depth expanded from 5 to 8 indicators (added class extends, instance where, variable co-occurrence), cap raised from 2.0 to 3.0. Rigor 7.15→7.18, Total +0.04. Both changes are legitimate quality measurements.
